Summary: One of the occult practices forbidden in Deuteronomy 18 and Leviticus 19: do not consult a medium. Israel was not to seek guidance from the dead or from hidden powers as the nations did.
Application: Scripture's stated reason: for all that do these things are an abomination unto the LORD (Deuteronomy 18:12). God's people seek him alone for guidance, through his word and his prophets.
